claim: Proxemics: how much air sits between two people, which an audience reads as intimacy or threat long before dialogue lands. Intimate crowds the frame and forces a reaction; distant makes the gap itself the subject of the shot.
method: identical subject sentence and seed in every panel; only the option clause changes. panels marked control render the untouched subject, because SDXL cannot express absence.

panels.clause: 2boys, faces almost touching, nose to nose
2boys, a few steps apart, standing apart
2boys, far apart, wide gap between them
2boys, very far apart, one tiny in the distance
